regime.title: FIPS 140-3 / ISO/IEC 19790 / SP 800-57 vocabulary: split knowledge and dual control
regime.determination_by: a CMVP testing laboratory and NIST, for a cryptographic module; nobody, for a vocabulary mapping

source.note: csrc.nist.gov was unreachable when this map was written; term definitions are our paraphrase and are unverified

preamble: A vocabulary row says which SecuraCV mechanism a reader of FIPS 140-3 / ISO/IEC 19790 language should look at. It is not a statement about module validation: SecuraCV has no validated cryptographic module and no FIPS level (row `validated-module`). The definitions are our paraphrase; NIST sources were not reachable.

rows.requirement: No one person holds or sees a whole secret.
rows.mechanism: The vault KEK pair is shared n-of-m with Pedersen VSS over ristretto255. Shares travel in HPKE boxes to holders. It is reconstructed only in memory inside the unseal gate, after a device-signed redemption row of a quorum-approved grant, and zeroized immediately after the DEK unwrap (spec/quorum_unseal_v2.md:84-89). Threshold decryption, in which the KEK never exists whole, is a named future seam, not this design.

rows.requirement: An action requires two or more people acting together.
rows.mechanism: n-of-m trustee approvals for grants and policy changes.

rows.requirement: Using the key itself needs several parties.
rows.mechanism: Release of shares at the gate.
The zeroization order of the release protocol.

rows.requirement: Key components are entered by separate parties.
rows.mechanism: Holder-side share release with the roster pinned in every share.

rows.requirement: A cryptographic module is validated under the CMVP.
rows.reason: Regulated-market assurance controls are absent by design from the consumer kernel and belong to a separate tier; nothing in this tree has CMVP module validation.

rows.requirement: Approved security functions are used in an approved mode.
rows.mechanism: Ed25519, SHA-256, ChaCha20-Poly1305, ML-KEM-768 and HPKE are named as algorithms only.
rows.reason: Approval is a property of module validation under the CMVP, which nothing in this tree has; naming algorithms states nothing about approval.
